minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved a new order of conditions for 390 New West Townsend Rd and a water main RDA; administrator's last night.
minutes.summary: The commission heard a notice of intent to re-permit a septic and house project at 390 New West Townsend Road whose 2017 order had expired, and a request for determination for a Lunenburg Water District main replacement on Mass Ave. It also ratified several administrative determinations, paid an invoice for Hollis Road toilets, and backed a Snow Riders bridge repair on the Calgary lot. It marked the conservation administrator's last meeting.

what_happened.line: The commission approved a new order of conditions for 390 New West Townsend Road, 4-0 by roll call, re-permitting a project whose 2017 order had expired.
It issued a negative determination of applicability for the Lunenburg Water District main replacement on Mass Ave, with 14 days' notice to the office before construction.
It voted to pay the Cleghorn Plumbing invoice for emergency toilet replacement at the Hollis Road house, unanimously.
It ratified the agent's tree-removal determinations at 131 White Street, 53 Pearl Street and 238 Fire Road 16.
It approved the Snow Riders' Calgary lot bridge repair; the next meeting is November 2, and election of officers was deferred.

why_it_matters: The water main decision lets the district's Mass Ave replacement go ahead without a full wetlands permit, and the 14-day notice is the commission's check on when work starts.
The Hollis Road invoice and the Calgary lot bridge repair draw on town conservation land and its accounts, so they bear on what the town spends there and how volunteer labor is used.
The conservation administrator's last meeting changes who handles permit filings and site determinations for residents until the post is filled.
watch_next: Next meeting November 2 at 7 PM, where the election of officers, deferred for lack of full attendance, is expected.
The list of appliances and heating systems at the Hollis Road house, due at the next meeting.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on all seven votes and their outcomes, the Cleghorn $1,471.56 payment, the roughly $28,000 timber figure and the postponed election of officers. They differ mainly in what each includes: ours has the DocuSign guidance, the Howard Street driveway and the next-meeting date, while the official minutes have the pollinator purchases and the town-counsel action item.
